source_section: Policy/Criteria - Section I.A General Use Cushions
source_quote: A general use seat cushion (E2601, E2602) and a general use wheelchair back cushion (E2611, E2612) for an approved manual wheelchair or power wheelchair with a sling or solid seat or back.
clinical_service_or_procedure: General use wheelchair seat and back cushions (HCPCS E2601, E2602, E2611, E2612)

criteria.description: Approved manual or power wheelchair with sling or solid seat/back

review_notes: General use cushions covered with an approved manual or power chair.

source_section: Policy/Criteria - Section I.B Skin Protection Cushions
source_quote: A skin-protection seat cushion (E2603, E2604, E2622, E2623) with an approved manual wheelchair or power wheelchair, with a sling/solid seat/back; and either of the following: 1. Current pressure ulcer or past history of a pressure ulcer
clinical_service_or_procedure: Skin-protection wheelchair seat cushion (HCPCS E2603, E2604, E2622, E2623)

criteria.description: Approved manual or power wheelchair with sling/solid seat/back
Current pressure ulcer or history of pressure ulcer at seating contact area OR absent/impaired sensation / inability to weight shift from qualifying neuro disease

required_documentation: Wound care or clinical notes documenting pressure ulcer history
Neurologic assessment documenting sensory loss or inability to perform weight shift
review_notes: Indicated for pressure ulcer history or qualifying neurological sensory loss.

source_quote: A positioning seat cushion (E2605, E2606), positioning back cushion (E2613, E2614, E2615, E2616, E2620, E2621), and positioning accessory (E0953, E0955, E0956, E0957, E0960) with both of the following: 1. An approved manual wheelchair or power wheelchair with a sling/solid seat/back; and 2. Significant postural asymmetries
clinical_service_or_procedure: Positioning seat and back cushions and accessories (HCPCS E2605, E2606, E2613-E2616, E2620, E2621, E0953, E0955, E0956, E0957, E0960)

criteria.description: Significant postural asymmetries due to qualifying neurological or musculoskeletal diagnosis

required_documentation: PT/OT seating evaluation detailing postural asymmetries
review_notes: Requires documentation of significant postural asymmetries from qualifying conditions.

source_quote: A headrest (E0955) when the member/enrollee has an approved manual tilt-in-space, manual semi or fully reclining back on a manual wheelchair, a manual fully reclining back on a power wheelchair, or power tilt and/or recline power seating system.

criteria.description: Approved manual tilt-in-space, reclining back, or power tilt/recline seating system

review_notes: Headrest indicated when wheelchair has tilt-in-space or recline feature.

source_quote: A combination skin-protection and positioning seat cushion (E2607, E2608, E2624, E2625) if the criteria for both a skin-protection seat cushion and a positioning seat cushion are met.
clinical_service_or_procedure: Combination skin-protection and positioning wheelchair seat cushion (HCPCS E2607, E2608, E2624, E2625)
required_documentation: Clinical records documenting both pressure ulcer/sensory deficit AND postural asymmetry
review_notes: Dual qualification: must meet skin-protection and positioning criteria simultaneously.

source_section: Policy/Criteria - Section I.F Custom Fabricated Cushions
source_quote: A custom fabricated seat cushion (E2609) if criteria (1) and (3) below are met. A custom fabricated back cushion (E2617) if criteria (2) and (3) below are met: 1. The member/enrollee meets all of the criteria for a prefabricated skin-protection seat cushion or positioning seat cushion; 2. The member/enrollee meets all of the criteria for a prefabricated positioning back cushion; 3. There is a comprehensive, written evaluation by a licensed/certified medical professional, such as a physical therapist (PT) or occupational therapist (OT), which clearly explains why a prefabricated seating system is not sufficient to meet seating and positioning needs. The PT or OT must have no financial relationship with the supplier.
clinical_service_or_procedure: Custom fabricated wheelchair seat or back cushion (HCPCS E2609, E2617)

criteria.description: Prefabricated cushion criteria met (skin protection or positioning)
Comprehensive evaluation by independent PT/OT explaining why prefab system is insufficient

required_documentation: Supplier conflict-of-interest attestation confirming no financial relationship
review_notes: Requires independent PT/OT evaluation explaining why prefab system fails.

source_quote: special wheelchair cushions and accessories are not medically necessary for the following indications: A. A general use seat cushion (E2601, E2602) if the member/enrollee has a power-operated vehicle (POV) or a power wheelchair with a captain's chair seat.
clinical_service_or_procedure: Wheelchair cushions and accessories on POV or Captain's Chair

criteria.description: Cushion requested for POV or power wheelchair with captain's chair seat
Cushion provided for use with transport chair (E1037, E1038)
Powered seat cushion (E2610) for any indication

review_notes: Excluded on captain's chair, transport chair, or powered seat cushion (E2610).
